title: The stack's figures: two marines in the black suit told apart, moving, in the shoot house (today's look and five candidates)
about: The v0.0.14 reviews: "You and your #2 merge into one blob on the walk" and "In the black suit the legs barely read". The suit stays black (the Corps' armour is black); five ways to keep the two men and their legs apart at 16 px/m, each beside today's look. Every view is the game's own picture of the hall at room 1's door (test-shoothouse at 10:00 on seed 48213: the house's light and floor, the fog of awareness, the post pass, the Mars palette; shot by capture.mjs with the stack moved out), with the stack drawn over it as the stage draws it: the game's figure code (walk cycle B's Combat glide at the low ready, side on with the plant lock; the stack's beat when still), lit by the tint the view gives a figure there, then the post pass's outline, grade and snap. S-h checks that drawing against the game's own picture of GO. The moment, 8.7 s looped: you and your #2 glide (1.23 m/s) from the start mark to the stack on room 1's door, one behind the other along the hall (one depth: the blob), then your #2 crosses in front of you to the door's far side (0.65 m nearer the camera). The gallery's pictures are stills at each tile's telling moment; open a view live (O) and it moves: Space stops and starts it, S slows it to a quarter, the arrows step a tick while stopped, R starts again. Score each candidate in motion; several can be joined (say which).

groups.title: S: the stack walking up to room 1's door and your #2 crossing in front of you, today's look and five candidates
groups.about: Each view: on the left the walk up (you and your #2 one behind the other along the hall, at one depth), on the right the pass (your #2 crossing in front of you, from the stack to the door's far side); live, each tile loops its own part of the moment. S0 is today's look as v0.0.14 draws it: the black shell and the darker skin snap to two of the palette's darks, the ink outline to a third as dark, the outline the post pass draws between two men at one depth is ink too, and the soft blob under each (0.84 m across) merges under two men 0.65 m apart. S1 a lit edge: each leg, boot and the far arm takes a pixel of cool grey on its edge toward the light (the upper left), so the legs show as lines that scissor. S2 a visor per man: yours the issue's smoked blue, your #2's gold. S3 the Navy's red tape on your #2: a band round his helmet over the visor, on his shoulders from the front and behind, on his near upper arm side on. S4 a pixel of the floor's tone between them: where one man lies over the other, the one under is cut back a pixel round him in the hall floor's colour (a post pass rule; today that pixel is ink). S5 a cast shadow per body: each man's legs laid flat on the floor away from the light, hard-edged, in place of the blob. S1 to S3 are the figure code's own marks (a look's mark, which no look in the game carries yet); S4 and S5 are drawn by the sample as the post pass and the stage's shadow would draw them. S-g puts the six side by side on one clock; S-h is the check.
